LITERACY ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: LITERACY ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which option best shows correct understanding of Imitation? (1 mark)
   A. Use Imitation to shame classmates.
   B. Treat Imitation as empty slogans with no facts.
   C. Apply Imitation with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   D. Copy a rumour about Imitation without checking.

2. Which option best shows correct understanding of Independent reading? (1 mark)
   A. Copy a rumour about Independent reading without checking.
   B. Treat Independent reading as empty slogans with no facts.

   D. Use Independent reading to shame classmates.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
